subject: Renewal & expansion pricing - volume step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Renewal & expansion pricing (volumes, blended rates, routes)

Thanks for the time today - good discussion. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Current baseline: Acme is planning to renew the existing deployment (~75M tokens/month today) and expand by adding 2 new routes (support chat + summarization pipeline) which we estimate will add ~40-60M tokens/month incremental in year 1.
- Pricing ask: target unit economics around $/1M tokens - you mentioned a target of roughly $700-800 / 1M tokens as a blended target across routes.
- Key decision points: committed monthly volume (affects tiered discounts and blended rate), length of commitment (12 vs 24 months), and whether new routes/models are included in the same blended bucket or priced as add-ons.

Next steps:
1) I'll send a written pricing summary with volume step-ups and blended-rate examples (attached).
2) Jordan - please confirm expected ramp by quarter (baseline + incremental) and any internal budget constraints.
3) If acceptable, we'll prepare an updated proposal + DocuSign for signature and align on PO timing.

Attachment: pricing_proposal_v3.pdf (pricing table + example blended calculations)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal & expansion pricing (volumes, blended rates, routes)

Thanks for the recap, Marissa. A couple quick clarifications before you finalize the proposal:

- On blended rates: can you show a worked example where baseline 75M + incremental 50M = 125M tokens/month and what the blended $/1M would be across tiers? We're specifically evaluating whether to treat the summarization route as a higher-cost model (10-15% uplift).
- Budget: Procurement is targeting ~$750 / 1M tokens as a target blended number for negotiations; willing to flex for multi-year commitments but need to see the math.
- Ramp: I expect Q2: +20M, Q3: +40M, Q4: +60M incremental (rough). I'll confirm with product next week.

Please include any DocuSign/next-step timelines in the proposal.

— Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal & expansion pricing (volumes, blended rates, routes)

Appreciate the details, Jordan - see the attached worked examples (example_calc.xlsx) and a clean proposal (pricing_proposal_v3.pdf). Summary below: 

Pricing summary (high level):
- Tier 1: 0-50M tokens/month = $1,100 / 1M tokens
- Tier 2: 50-150M tokens/month = $850 / 1M tokens
- Tier 3: 150-500M tokens/month = $650 / 1M tokens

Blended example (75M baseline + 50M incremental = 125M):
- First 50M at $1,100 = $55,000
- Next 75M at $850 = $63,750
- Total = $118,750 -> blended = $950 / 1M tokens

Notes on add-ons / routes:
- If the summarization route uses a heavier model profile, we recommend a +12% uplift on that route's tokens (applied before blending). If both new routes are standard models, they can be included in the blended tiers.
- Volume step-ups: we provide standard step discounts at 3 volume breakpoints (50M, 150M, 500M). For multi-route expansions, we can offer blended calculations across routes to hit your target economics.

Suggested options to hit your ~$750 target: 
A) 24-month commitment with 200M monthly committed volume -> blended falls to ~ $700 / 1M (example in sheet).
B) 12-month commitment + 3% additional uplift for route-specific models and a 10% multi-route loyalty credit after Q2 ramp.

Rishi - can you confirm internal approval on the heavier-model uplift (12%) and whether we can offer a 5% one-time concession if they commit to a 12-month term for the extra routes?

Next steps: I'll update the proposal based on your ramp confirmation and send a DocuSign link for signature.

Attachments: pricing_proposal_v3.pdf, example_calc.xlsx

Best,
Marissa

--

- Applied 5% one-time concession on blended calculation upon 12-month commitment for incremental routes.
- Included a 24-month alternative that brings blended to ~ $700 / 1M at 200M committed monthly.

Next steps:
